key_insight: TopoAgent is an LLM-based agentic framework that automatically chooses the most suitable topological descriptor for a medical image dataset and generates topological features for downstream analysis.
clinical_relevance: This could make topology-based image analysis easier to deploy in medical imaging workflows by reducing manual descriptor selection and feature engineering.
method: Uses a Perception–Reasoning–Action–Reflection loop to inspect images and decide on topology features.
Relies on 21 domain-specific tools plus dual memory to reuse experience across runs.
Selects and configures the best topological descriptor without task-specific training.
evidence_signal: The framework’s skills were distilled from evaluations of 15 topological descriptors across 26 datasets using six classifiers.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of the descriptor library and tool design, so results may not generalize equally well to all imaging tasks or unseen data types.
paper_title: TopoAgent: An Agentic Framework for Automated Topology Learning in Medical Imaging
